items.title: Per-user storage and ordered inbox query
items.precondition: Isolated PostgreSQL with users A, B, C and multiple conversations.
steps: A pins two conversations; B pins a different conversation.
Send a newer message to A's unpinned conversation and inspect both inboxes.
items.expected: Migration and index apply once; A sees only A's pins in stable order; B sees only B's priority state; activity reorders only unpinned rows.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: product owner manually confirmed the feature acceptance.

items.title: Mutation authorization and idempotence
items.precondition: A and B share a conversation; C is not a participant.
steps: A pins twice and unpins twice.
Observe B while A changes priority.
items.expected: A succeeds idempotently; C receives existing 403; B's priority and events do not change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: product owner manually confirmed the feature acceptance.

items.title: Inbox menu, pin icon, priority, and live refresh
items.precondition: A has a target chat, a newer unpinned chat, and two browser tabs; B participates in the target chat.
steps: Confirm a pin icon appears beside that profile name only in A's inbox.
Observe both A tabs, refresh, unpin, and verify swipe Delete.
items.expected: Label toggles; the pin icon appears and disappears with A's priority; pinned chat stays on top through activity and refresh; A's second tab reloads; B never receives A's icon or reorder; unpin restores normal recency; swipe deletion remains intact.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: product owner manually confirmed the feature acceptance.
items.notes: The icon uses the existing icon system and is decorative beside the displayed profile name.

items.title: Delete clears priority and restore is normal
items.precondition: A has pinned a conversation with B.
steps: B sends A a new message and A reloads the inbox.
Repeat by restoring through direct thread navigation.
items.expected: Only A's pin is removed transactionally; both inbound and direct restore return the row as unpinned.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: product owner manually confirmed the feature acceptance.

items.title: Build, tests, and architecture gates
steps: Run npm run typecheck and npm run build.
Run impacted tests, npm run check:conventions --strict, and audit when available.
items.expected: All execution-caused failures are fixed or expressly waived with evidence.
items.evidence: 2026-08-06: npm run typecheck and npm run build passed. Production build reported only the existing Vite chunk-size advisory.
items.notes: No root test or check:conventions script is configured.
